scripts.dist: rm -rf dist && HAPP_BUILD_MODE=Retail npm run build
scripts.devtest: UI_PORT=$(port) HC_APP_PORT=$(port) HC_ADMIN_PORT=$(port) HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' concurrently "npm run new-sandbox" "sleep 5 && npm run start:ui"
scripts.new-sandbox: RUST_LOG=warn WASM_LOG=debug echo "pass" | hc s --holochain-path holochain --piped -f=$HC_ADMIN_PORT generate ../artifacts/where.happ --run=$HC_APP_PORT -a where-moss-tool
